queue.undone: The queue went one step back
queue.redone: The queue went one step forward

source.title: Choose a source
source.desc: Open an ISO, WIM, ESD or SWM, or pick an extracted setup folder.
source.removeBody: {name} will be removed from the list. This folder is the work copy WinLove extracted from the ISO ({path}); delete it from the disk too, along with the modified image in it? The original ISO is not touched.
source.deleteFailed: Could not delete the work copy
source.captureNote: {folder} → {wim}. An existing file gets a new edition. Needs administrator rights; the running system's own drive cannot be captured.
source.hashMismatch: ✗ Does not match — the file differs or is damaged
source.droppedMany: {n} more source(s) added to the recent list
source.mountedHint: Images mounted by other tools (DISM, NTLite …) are here too. Double-click / Enter: work on it · Delete: unmount, discarding changes
source.mountedBusy: Save or discard the image open in WinLove first
source.discardBody: The image in {folder} is unmounted; changes made but not saved are lost. The WIM file stays as it is.
source.hostTitle: This Windows' DISM files have a problem
source.hostUsingAdk: WinLove uses the Windows ADK's DISM.
source.hostAdkInstalled: The Windows ADK is installed: its wimgapi is used when needed.
source.hostInstallAdk: Image operations may fail; with the Windows ADK's Deployment Tools installed WinLove uses its DISM.

download.title: Download Windows
download.desc: Download any Windows build from Microsoft's update servers and turn it into an ISO.
download.listFailed: The list of builds could not be loaded
download.listFailedBody: UUP dump does not answer right now, or there is no connection. Press Refresh in a moment.
download.pickBody: Choose the Windows build to download in the list on the left.
download.updatesHint: The cumulative update, .NET and Edge go into the image. Conversion takes 30–60 min.
download.note: The list comes from UUP dump; the files come straight from Microsoft, each checked against its SHA-256.
download.stoppedBody: The files downloaded so far stay; starting again continues from there.
download.busy: Another image job is running; the conversion starts when it ends.
download.appsBody: The ones switched on go into the ISO; the ones switched off are not installed. The frameworks they need come along.

images.title: Editions
images.desc: Manage editions in the image: mount, export, rename, delete, verify.
images.queueRestored: The last session's queue is back: {count} changes
images.mountDiscarded: A broken mount from the last session was cleaned up
images.emptyBody: Open an ISO, WIM or setup folder to see its editions.
images.esdNoMount: ESD cannot be mounted — convert ESD → WIM first
images.deleteNeedsWim: An ESD or a split image cannot be edited — convert it to WIM first
images.lastEdition: The image has only one edition
images.unmountBody: Save the changes in the mounted image to the WIM file? If you discard, the file stays unchanged.
images.unmountQueued: {count} queued changes have not been applied yet: unmounting deletes them. Save only writes what was already done in the image to the WIM.
images.workCopyTitle: This ISO has a work copy
images.workCopyModified: {folder} changed after it was extracted from this ISO (an image was saved, editions edited). Extracting again deletes those changes.
images.workCopyUnknown: {folder} holds setup files extracted earlier; which ISO they came from and whether they changed is not known. Extracting again deletes what is there.
images.workCopyOtherSource: {folder} is the work copy of another ISO with the same name. Extracting this ISO deletes that copy.
images.workCopyOther: The work folder holds another ISO's copy with the same name
images.actionsHint: Mount, export or delete this edition.
images.unmountRecovered: Unmounted — open windows were moved away and it was retried
images.folderForeign: holds files that are not an image — not deleted; choose an empty folder in Settings
images.verifyHint: Reads every stream of the image and compares it with its SHA-1; the image is not changed
images.verifyEsd: An ESD cannot be verified — convert ESD → WIM first
images.verifySoundBody: {n} streams read ({size}); every one matches its SHA-1.
images.verifyDamagedBody: {n} of {total} streams do not match their SHA-1. Download or copy the file again; the log lists where they are.
images.keepOne: The image must keep at least one edition
images.selectedHint: {n} editions selected: export or delete them.
images.upgradeHint: Turns the mounted image into a higher edition (e.g. Home → Pro); runs with Apply
images.upgradeNone: This edition cannot be turned into a higher one
images.upgradeRemovedToast: Edition upgrade removed from the queue
images.readingEditions: {edition}: reading the editions it can become
images.exploreMountHint: Open the mount folder in File Explorer (Ctrl+E)
images.terminalHere: Open a command prompt in the mount folder
images.revealFile: Show the file in its folder
images.copiedToast: Edition details copied to the clipboard
images.toolsHint: Compression, SWM, editions from another image
images.recompressNote: Now: {now}. Every edition is written into a new file, which then takes the old one's place.
images.splitNote: Split as install.swm, install2.swm …; Setup reads them from a FAT32 stick.
images.appendNote: The editions ticked in {file} are added to this image; shared files are stored once.
images.appendNone: This file has no Windows edition to add (only setup media or Windows PE).
images.movedToast: {edition} moved: Setup lists the editions in this order
images.duplicateNote: A copy of the edition is added at the end: it can be customised on its own, the files stay shared (a few MB).
images.splitNeedsWim: An ESD cannot be split: convert it to WIM first
images.swmOnly: Only a split (.swm) image is joined

components.title: Components
components.desc: Check the components to remove. Dependencies and irreversible operations are flagged automatically.
components.emptyBody: Open an image and mount an edition to list components.
components.readingBody: DISM is reading the image's provisioned apps and their sizes.
components.presetNeedsMount: Mount an edition before loading a preset
components.deepWarning: Cannot be undone; later cumulative updates may fail to install — add updates in the same Apply.

features.title: Windows Features
features.desc: Optional features and Features on Demand. Disabled items stay in the image, only turned off.
features.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to see its features.
features.loadingBody: DISM is reading the image's features and their names (takes a moment the first time).

updates.title: Updates
updates.desc: Drop MSU / CAB packages. Ordering is automatic: SSU → LCU → .NET → other.
updates.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to add updates.
updates.unknown: Not checkable from the file name
updates.emptyList: No packages yet — drop .msu / .cab files or use Add package.
updates.catalogBody: The newest cumulative, .NET, WinRE (Safe OS) and setup file (Setup) updates for Windows {release} {arch} ({build}). The files are downloaded into the work folder and checked with SHA-256; the image's are queued, the setup media's apply on Build ISO.
updates.catalogNone: The catalog has no update for this version
updates.noTarget: This Windows version cannot be looked up in the catalog
updates.downloadedNoMount: {n} update(s) downloaded (no image mounted: not queued)
updates.downloadStopped: Download stopped — it resumes where it left off

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.desc: Scan INF folders, group by class, integrate into the image.
drivers.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to add drivers.
drivers.emptyBody: Scan a folder with INF files (e.g. a vendor driver pack). Subfolders are included.
drivers.imageLoadingBody: DISM is listing the driver store…
drivers.imageNone: No third-party drivers in the image
drivers.imageNoneBody: Only Windows' own (inbox) drivers are there; those are not removed here.
drivers.imageHint: A ticked driver is removed from the image's driver store. Boot-critical ones (storage, chipset) can break setup.
drivers.hostExported: {n} driver packages taken — pick them on the first tab
drivers.hostFailed: Could not take this PC's drivers
drivers.bootHint: Added to boot.wim when the ISO / USB is made: so Setup sees the disk (RAID / VMD) or the network

registry.title: Registry
registry.desc: Your own registry values and .reg files. Ready-made tweaks are on the Settings / Tweaks page.
registry.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to add registry values.
registry.noEntries: No entries yet — use "Add value…" / "Import .reg…" above or drag and drop
registry.tweaksMoved: Ready-made tweaks (privacy, performance, appearance…) are on the Settings / Tweaks page
registry.valueBody: Written into the image: HKLM\SOFTWARE, HKLM\SYSTEM, HKCR, HKCU (new users), HKU\.DEFAULT. HKCC only after setup.
registry.valueAfterSetup: Re-apply after setup (if Windows resets it during setup)
registry.valueHintText: Written as typed; may be empty
registry.valueHintMulti: Separate the lines with ; (;; = a single ;)
registry.valueHintDeleteValue: The value is deleted from the image
registry.valueHintDeleteKey: The key is deleted with all its subkeys
registry.valueBadKey: The key must start with HKLM\…, HKCU\…, HKCR\…, HKU\…
registry.valueBadData: The data does not fit this type
registry.valueNoHive: This key cannot be written into an image (SAM, SECURITY, other users)

services.title: Services
services.desc: Edit startup types. Dependent services are flagged with the change.
services.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to edit services.
services.loadingBody: Loading the image's SYSTEM registry hive; names are resolved from the image's files.
services.dependentsWarn: {name} disabled: {n} services that depend on it cannot start

tweaks.title: Settings / Tweaks
tweaks.desc: Each row shows the state of that feature in the installed Windows: On = the feature stays on. What you change becomes registry and service operations.
tweaks.fileProblem: No JPEG the image can take at this path (.jpg, 64 MB at most)
tweaks.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to change its settings.
tweaks.recommendedApplied: {n} settings set to the recommended value
tweaks.recommendedNone: Every recommended setting is already selected
tweaks.pagefileProblem: Format: a drive and two sizes (MB), e.g. "D: 4096 8192", or "D:" alone
tweaks.fromThisPcDone: {n} settings set the way this PC has them
tweaks.fromThisPcNone: This PC's settings are the image's already

unattended.title: Unattended Setup
unattended.desc: Build autounattend.xml. The preview on the right updates with every change.
unattended.storage: Skip the disk size check (64 GB)
unattended.computerNameHint: Empty: Windows picks a random name
unattended.accountHint: Empty: setup asks for the account
unattended.productKeyHint: Empty: the edition's generic key is written (activate after setup); with the edition unknown, setup asks
unattended.includeInIsoHint: Written to the ISO root as autounattend.xml when the ISO is built
unattended.problemComputerName: 15 characters at most; no spaces or punctuation
unattended.problemAccountName: This account name cannot be used
unattended.problemAutoLogon: Enter the local account name first
unattended.saveFailed: Could not save the answer file
unattended.importFailed: Could not read the answer file
unattended.compactOsHint: Windows files stay compressed on the disk: saves a few GB
unattended.randomNameHint: Setup makes one up (ComputerName "*"); the name above is not written.
unattended.extraAccountsHint: name=password, name2 — comma separated; a name alone has no password
unattended.builtInAdminHint: Switched on, with the password below (specialize: net user /active:yes).
unattended.recoveryHint: 1000 MB at the start of the disk; Windows RE goes there.
unattended.noEncryptionHint: BitLocker does not encrypt the disk on its own after setup.
unattended.logonCommandHint: At the first logon of the first account (FirstLogonCommands).
unattended.problemExtraAccounts: A further account name is not valid or repeats
unattended.problemDiskId: Must be a number from 0 to 63
unattended.welcomeHint: Asks during Setup, after the logo; Apply writes the script into the image.
unattended.welcomeAskComputer: Ask for the computer's name and time zone
unattended.welcomeAskLook: Ask for the theme and accent colour
unattended.welcomeEmptyPassword: Allow an account without a password
unattended.welcomeUsed: The welcome screen asks for the account

postsetup.title: Post-Setup
postsetup.desc: Steps that run at first logon: app installs, commands, file copies.
postsetup.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to add post-setup steps.
postsetup.empty: No steps — add a command, files or an app from the header
postsetup.keysHint: Enter edits · Delete removes · Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ moves
postsetup.wingetLater: winget steps run at the first logon: the SYSTEM account has no winget.
postsetup.name: Name
postsetup.commandHint: One line, as typed into cmd
postsetup.commandsBody: What is set with a command rather than a registry value: power plan, sleep timeouts, firewall. They run with the post-setup plan.
postsetup.pickTitle: Files to copy into the image
postsetup.wifiKeyHint: Plain text in the preset and on the setup media; deleted from the disk after setup

apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: {n} changes are ready. At the end the image is saved and unmounted.
apply.highRiskBody: Removing {items}. These cannot be undone in the image; you will be asked again on the confirmation screen.
apply.highRiskBodyMixed: {items}: what is removed cannot be undone in the image; the confirmation screen asks again.
apply.highRiskBodySettings: {items} change; the confirmation screen asks again.
apply.etaBody: The image stays mounted while applying; do not put the computer to sleep.
apply.confirmBody: The components below will be permanently removed from the image. They cannot be re-added afterwards.
apply.confirmBodyMixed: Removed components cannot be added back to this image; the settings can affect the security or stability of the installed system.
apply.confirmBodySettings: These settings can affect the security or stability of the installed system.
apply.doneDesc: {n} changes applied in {t}. Image committed and unmounted.
apply.successBody: New install.wim size {after} (−{gain}). Finished with {w} warning(s).

reason.appxProtected: Windows does not let this app be removed from the image
reason.permanentPackage: Permanent package: Windows does not let it be removed
reason.pending: The image has pending operations (a feature enabled in this run finishes at first boot); the image was not affected

apply.emptyBody: Changes you pick on Features and the other pages collect here and are applied together.
apply.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to pick and apply changes.
apply.skippedBody: The other changes were applied and the image was saved. What was skipped is listed below with the reason.
apply.commitFailedBody: Changes were applied but the image could not be saved: {e}. It is still mounted; try unmounting on the Images page.
apply.heldTitle: {n} operations failed — the image was not saved
apply.heldDesc: What succeeded is in the mounted image; it is still mounted. Saving or discarding is your call.
apply.heldBody: The failed step may have left the image half changed. Check the reasons, then Apply again or unmount it.
apply.stoppedDesc: {done} / {total} operations applied; the image stays mounted, the rest is queued.
apply.stoppedBody: Applied operations are in the mounted image; the rest is still queued. Press Apply again or unmount.

iso.title: Build ISO / Write USB
iso.desc: Create a bootable ISO or write directly to a USB drive.
iso.label: Volume label
iso.noPrompt: No "Press any key to boot from CD" prompt
iso.bootBypass: Also write the requirement bypasses into boot.wim
iso.bootBypassNone: No requirement check is switched off on the Unattended page
iso.mediaUpdateBox: Update boot.wim and the setup files
iso.mediaUpdateNone: Available once the cumulative and Setup updates are downloaded on Updates › Catalog
iso.legacySetupHint: Opens the Windows 10 style Setup instead of the new one
iso.legacySetupNoWinre: install.wim has no WinRE: the new Setup cannot install it (fails at ~5%)
iso.legacySetupNewFails: new Setup — no WinRE, it will fail
iso.legacySetupClassic: This setup media predates 24H2: it opens the previous Setup already
iso.aioReplaced: Setup media replaced: every edition can be installed
iso.repackOnlyWork: Only setup files in WinLove's work folder are repacked
iso.blockNoSource: Open a source first (ISO or setup folder).
iso.blockWimOnly: A bootable ISO cannot be made from a single WIM/ESD file; open a setup folder or ISO.
iso.blockMounted: An image is mounted: finish Apply or unmount it on the Images page first.
iso.blockUnattend: The answer file has a value Windows Setup would reject: fix it on the Unattended Setup page or turn off "Add to the ISO".
iso.unattendOff: not added · "Add to the ISO" is off
iso.stageExtract: Extracting the ISO to the work folder
iso.usbErase: Everything on the chosen USB drive is erased. The system disk is never listed.
iso.usbTooSmall: The setup files do not fit on this drive ({need} needed)
iso.usbConfirmTitle: Erase and write the USB drive?
iso.usbConfirmBody: Everything on {disk} ({size}{letters}) is erased and Windows setup is written to it. This cannot be undone.
iso.usbCancelled: Writing the USB drive stopped — the drive is incomplete, write it again
iso.usbFailed: Could not write the USB drive
iso.welcomeMissingTitle: The welcome screen is not in the image
iso.welcomeMissingBody: The answer file turns the welcome screen on but edition {editions} has no script for it: Setup would end up without an account. Run Apply first or turn the welcome off in Unattended Setup.
iso.secureBootUntrusted: Will not start on this PC: its boot certificates lack Windows UEFI CA 2023
iso.secureBootUnknown: Will not start on older PCs without the 2023 certificate

presets.title: Presets
presets.desc: Save, load, share and compare setting sets.
presets.name: Preset name
presets.newBody: The current queue and the unattended setup answers are saved to the library under this name.
presets.deleteBody: "{name}" is removed from the library for good.
presets.empty: No presets yet: "New preset" saves the current queue

logs.title: Logs
logs.desc: Session log and DISM output. Filter by level, export.

settings.title: App settings
settings.desc: Appearance and working environment of WinLove.
settings.densityHint: Windows' text size setting counts too
settings.lockedHint: Cannot change while an image is mounted or a job is running
settings.pathInvalid: A full path is needed (e.g. D:\WinLove)
settings.mountNotEmpty: The mount folder must be empty
settings.resetDone: Settings are back to the defaults

palette.noResultsHint: Try a page name, command or component name.

dialogs.adminBody: WinLove must run as administrator to mount and modify images. The app will restart.
dialogs.deleteIndexBody: {name} will be permanently deleted from the image. The image file is rewritten with the editions that stay.
dialogs.keepOnlyBody: Only {name} will stay; the other {n} editions will be permanently deleted from the image. The image file is rewritten.
dialogs.deleteIsoNote: The ISO is copied to the work folder first; the ISO file itself is not changed.
dialogs.busyShutdown: WinLove is writing an image; shutting down now leaves the image or the stick half written

dialogs.deleteManyBody: {names} will be permanently deleted from the image. The image file is rewritten with the editions that stay.
dialogs.keepManyBody: The {k} selected editions will stay; the other {n} will be permanently deleted from the image. The image file is rewritten.
dialogs.renameHint: Windows Setup's edition list and DISM show this name.
dialogs.upgradeBody: The mounted image ({name}) becomes the edition you pick in the first step of Apply, and its name follows. There is no way back: an image cannot go down to a lower edition.

errors.ioError: Could not be read or written: {what}

shell.pendingTitle: This page is not built yet
shell.pendingBody: Arrives with step {id} on the roadmap.

remedy.closeOpenFiles: Files or folders are open in the mount folder (e.g. an Explorer window). Repair moves windows away and removes leftovers.
remedy.repairFolder: The mount folder was left inconsistent. Repair removes the leftovers (unsaved changes are lost).
remedy.remount: The image needs to be remounted (usually after a restart). Repair remounts it.
remedy.unmountFirst: An image is already mounted in this folder or from this WIM. Unmount it first.
remedy.convertEsd: ESD compression cannot be mounted. Convert ESD → WIM first.
remedy.checkPermissions: No write access to the WIM, or the app is not elevated.
remedy.disableScanners: Antivirus or the search indexer is touching the mount folder. Exclude it and retry.
remedy.useLocalFixedDrive: The mount folder must be on a local fixed NTFS drive and not a drive root.
remedy.waitForOther: Another DISM operation is using the image. Wait for it and retry.
remedy.notSupported: This operation is not supported for this image.
remedy.wimLibrary: Windows' WIM library (wimgapi) could not read this file. After this PC's copy WinLove also tries the other Microsoft copies it finds (the Windows ADK's, the setup media's sources folder). tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
tasks.desc: Ticked tasks are switched off after setup (SetupComplete, schtasks). A task the edition lacks is only logged.
tasks.detailHint: A task switched off does not run after setup; Windows Update may switch some on again.
tasks.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to pick tasks.
tasks.recommendedDone: {n} recommended tasks will be switched off
tasks.recommendedNone: Every recommended task is off already

tasks.addInvalid: That is not a task path

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.desc: Block lists for the image's hosts file. Each list is a section of its own; other lines of the file are left alone.
hosts.summary: {n} host names are blocked after Uygula (0.0.0.0)
hosts.customHint: Entries imported from a hosts file. Del removes them; ticking the empty row opens an import.
hosts.hint: Select a list: what it blocks is described here.
hosts.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to edit its hosts file.
hosts.importedNone: No new entries in the file

files.title: Files
files.desc: Files and folders of this PC are copied to the chosen place in the image; the installed Windows has them there.
files.empty: No files yet — drop some or use the buttons above
files.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to add files.
files.whereBody: {what} will be in this folder of the installed Windows (its name is kept).
files.someRefused: Some items could not be added
files.notSystemDrive: Only a place on drive C: can be chosen
files.placeRoot: the root of the system drive

icons.pickFile: Pick a file on the left
icons.pickTitle: Pick an icon or a picture
icons.notSource: This is not an icon or a picture Windows can read

startmenu.title: Start menu
startmenu.desc: Clean up the Windows 11 Start, pin the apps you want, switch off suggestions and ads.
startmenu.applyOnceHint: Off: the list comes back at every sign-in
startmenu.noteWindows: Windows pins its own: Edge, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 and promoted placeholders (Spotify, WhatsApp …).
startmenu.noteEmpty: Start's Pinned section opens empty; no promoted placeholders. No tiles on Windows 10 either.
startmenu.noteCustom: Only the apps on the right, in this order. Add from the left with a double click / Enter; on the right Delete removes, Ctrl+Left/Right moves.
startmenu.noteEdition: On every edition Start begins from an empty state with no ads. Your list applies exactly from 26100 / 26200.9457 on, on every edition (Home included); on an older build Start opens empty.
startmenu.noMountBody: Mount an edition on the Images page to customize its Start menu.
startmenu.oldBuild: This image's build ({build}) does not apply your list: Start opens empty (no ads). The list applies from 26200.9457 / 26100.9457 — add the latest cumulative update on the Updates page.
startmenu.taskbarUnpinHint: On: an unpinned app stays unpinned · off: pinned again at every sign-in
startmenu.taskbarNoteWindows: Windows pins its own: Edge, Microsoft Store, File Explorer and the placeholders it adds later (Outlook …).
startmenu.taskbarNoteEmpty: No apps are pinned to the taskbar; Start, search and open windows stay.
startmenu.taskbarNoteCustom: Only the apps on the right, left to right in this order; no Edge, Store or placeholders. Add from the left with a double click / Enter; on the right Delete removes, Ctrl+Left/Right moves.
startmenu.taskbarNoteHow: Written with Microsoft's Start Layout policy (tried on 26200.8037).
startmenu.taskbarWindows10: The taskbar layout is for Windows 11 images: on Windows 10 the same policy also locks the Start tiles.

compat.title: Compatibility guards
compat.body: A guard that is on keeps the apps and components it needs from being removed and its services from being disabled; what clashes with it leaves the queue. The runtimes kept apps use are always kept.

welcome.name: User name
welcome.computerHint: Up to 15 characters: letters, digits and hyphens.
welcome.accountSub: Create the account that will use this PC. It's a local account; no Microsoft account needed.
welcome.pcSub: Its name shows on the network and over Bluetooth; the time zone sets the clock and the date.
welcome.lookSub: Windows opens in these colours; Settings changes them later.
welcome.privacySub: Choose how much data Windows collects.
welcome.errorNameChars: A user name cannot have these characters: " / \ [ ] : ; | = , + * ? < > @ %
welcome.errorNameTaken: This name cannot be used; choose another.
welcome.errorPasswords: The passwords are not the same.
welcome.errorComputer: A computer name has 1–15 characters: letters, digits and hyphens.
welcome.doneSub: It takes a few seconds; then the PC restarts and your account opens.
welcome.stepComputer: Setting the computer's name and time zone
welcome.privacyStrictDetail: Only required diagnostic data is sent; the rest is off.
welcome.privacyWindowsDetail: Windows' own settings; Settings › Privacy changes them.
welcome.networkSub: Updates and apps need the internet; you can also go on without connecting for now.
welcome.networkEnterprise: Enterprise network: connect once Windows is up
welcome.networkFailed: Couldn't connect. Check the key and try again.
welcome.networkWired: You're connected to a wired network.
welcome.networkPreview: The preview doesn't connect to networks.
welcome.prefsSub: Set Windows up the way you work; Settings can change it later.
welcome.prefExtDetail: Like Report.docx; easier to tell files apart.
welcome.prefHiddenDetail: Files and folders Windows hides show too.
welcome.prefThisPc: Open File Explorer to This PC
welcome.prefClassicDetail: The full menu at once; no Show more options.
welcome.prefSearchDetail: When off, search stays in the Start menu.
welcome.privacyStrictFacts: Required diagnostics;Advertising ID off;Activity history off;Typing personalization off
welcome.failedFallback: Windows will go on with its own account page.
welcome.readySub: Windows finishes setup and restarts the PC.
